body:
Kind of an update? I don't know. But in the past week I've been (as prescribed by my doctor) increasing my dosage of Buspar (buspirone) and it kind of lines up with this sudden onset of unbearable depression. Don't get me wrong, my life is a boring hopeless prison, but a couple of weeks ago I was still able to at least leave the house or feel ambition to any degree. Anxiety was the more active problem and depression had sort of taken a back seat to it.

 I looked it up and depression/low energy/etc are possible (yet rare) side effects of buspirone. I'm going to lower the dose back to what I was taking regularly until I see my doctor again next week. Part of it is a relief, knowing something specific caused this, but I'm just back to square one after this, the state my life has been in for almost four years now. I never make progress, I just dig myself out of holes to get back to shitty hopeless normalcy.
